title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in the Choluteca, Colón, Cortes, Francisco Morazán, Intibucá, La Paz, districts of Honduras, contributes to outcome 3.1 Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. The objective is that women, older adolescent girls and GBV survivors use GBV specialised interventions and psychosocial support to meet their needs and preferences. Activities include strengthening GBV referral pathways; awareness raising of the legal framework and referrals; and the provision of psychosocial and other supports to GBV survivors. The programme is in partnership with Las Hormigas, CNTC La Paz, AMDV, AYO, ACDV, CEM-H, and FSAR. Other partners may be included. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:Women’s protection and access to specialised GBV supports
